document.cue: Describe a teacher who taught you something important.

text: I'd like to tell you about my English teacher, Ms Aigerim, who taught me when I was in high school. She was about forty years old at that time, and she always wore nice clothes and smiled a lot. She taught English, but she also taught us how to be confident.

Her lessons were never boring. We often played games, watched short videos and discussed interesting topics in pairs. If somebody made a mistake, she never laughed. Instead, she explained it slowly and gave another example. Before that, I was afraid of speaking English because I thought my pronunciation was bad. After a few months in her class, I started to answer questions without fear. She also gave us small books to read at home, and that helped my vocabulary a lot. Her classes were also very friendly, and we all felt like one team. Every week she also asked us to write a short diary in English, and she always wrote a kind comment at the end. At first I thought it was a lot of work, but little by little writing became easier, and I started to enjoy it.

I think she was important to me because she changed my attitude to learning. Now I enjoy studying languages, and I even want to become a teacher myself. Last year I met her in the street, and she remembered my name, which made me very happy. I will always be thankful to her for her patience and support.

tips.en: Every bullet is covered in order, so the talk sounds complete.
tips.kk: Жоспардың әр тармағы ретімен ашылған, сондықтан әңгіме тұтас естіледі.
tips.ru: Каждый пункт плана раскрыт по порядку, поэтому рассказ звучит целостно.
tips.example: I'd like to tell you about my English teacher, Ms Aigerim

tips.en: A before-and-after comparison shows development and fills the time.
tips.kk: «Бұрын және кейін» салыстыруы дамуды көрсетіп, уақытты толтырады.
tips.ru: Сравнение «до и после» показывает развитие и заполняет время.
tips.example: After a few months in her class, I started to answer questions without fear

tips.en: Feelings and a reason at the end answer the final 'and explain...' bullet.
tips.kk: Соңындағы эмоция мен себеп «and explain...» тармағына жауап береді.
tips.ru: Эмоции и причина в конце отвечают на последний пункт «and explain...».
tips.example: I think she was important to me because she changed my attitude to learning

note.en: Introduction: who the teacher was, the subject and a first impression.
note.kk: Кіріспе: ол кім екені, пәні және алғашқы әсер.
note.ru: Вступление: кто это был, предмет и первое впечатление.

note.en: Body: teaching methods and the change in you — a before-and-after example.
note.kk: Негізгі бөлім: оқыту әдістері және сіздегі өзгеріс — «бұрын және кейін» мысалы.
note.ru: Основная часть: методы обучения и перемена в вас — пример «до и после».

note.en: Conclusion: why the teacher matters and a note of thanks.
note.kk: Қорытынды: бұл мұғалімнің неге маңызды екені және алғыс.
note.ru: Заключение: почему этот учитель важен, и благодарность.

document.title: A teacher who inspired you
bullets: and explain why this teacher was important to you.
